== Notes ==
* Like all Eye of the North [[boss-like foe]]s, Bison has half activation time for his skills and does double damage with his attacks, which can be deadly to characters with a low [[armor rating]] such as [[caster]]s. 
* See [[Guide to the Norn Fighting Tournament]] for tips on defeating him.
* Using a [[Boreal Tonic]] will allow players to look like Bison for the duration of the tonic.

== Trivia ==
* This NPC's name is a reference to the Street Fighter II character [[w:M. Bison|M. Bison]].
* This NPC's first name is a reference to [[w:M%C3%B3%C3%B0i_and_Magni|Móði and Magni]], the sons of [[w:Thor|Thor]] and [[w:J%C3%A1rnsaxa|Járnsaxa]] in [[w:Norse_mythology|Norse mythology]].
* Magni's line "Show me how defenceless you really are" is a reference to the [[w:Breaking Benjamin|Breaking Benjamin]] song "So Cold."
